subject.title: Backup: add encrypted snapshot backup flow

question: Should OpenClaw core own this folder-backed encrypted snapshot backup surface, including the new `backup` config keys and restore behavior, once the security and recovery blockers are fixed?
rationale: This is not just a mechanical bug fix: it adds core configuration, a backup identity model, and destructive restore behavior around sensitive state and credentials.

options.title: Sponsor core backup after fixes
options.body: Keep this as a core feature candidate, but require the symlink, recovery-discovery, conflict, proof, and upgrade-safety blockers to be cleared before merge.

options.title: Narrow to archive lifecycle
options.body: Accept only a smaller local archive/restore improvement and leave folder-backed snapshot identity and cloud-drive mirroring for a later design.

options.title: Move snapshot flow outside core
options.body: Route the folder-backed/off-machine backup workflow to a plugin or ClawHub-style package unless a missing core API is identified.

recommendation.title: Sponsor core backup after fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this as a core feature candidate, but require the symlink, recovery-discovery, conflict, proof, and upgrade-safety blockers to be cleared before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They reviewed/co-authored the initial backup CLI merge and have adjacent backup hardening history, making them the best routing candidate for product/security direction.
